Chapter 1161 - 23: Overwhelming Might Across Void Domains (Seeking Monthly Tickets At The Beginning Of The Month)_2

Chapter 1161: Chapter 23: Overwhelming Might Across Void Domains (Seeking Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)_2

"Although the losses were heavy... at least we retreated with our lives..."

Dual Origin Great Saint sighed. With his understanding of causality, he naturally sensed that the causal lines of Great Saints like Wild Barbarian Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint still existed within the Xuanhuang Universe.

This means that these Great Saints’ main battle bodies in the Xuanhuang Universe have not yet died.

In such an extreme suppression of space-time, the life and death of the suppressed Chaos Great Saints were at Lin Yuan’s whim. Their survival indicated that Lin Yuan did not intend to kill them.

Why did he not plan to kill them? Naturally, it was to gain more benefits.

The main battle bodies of each Chaos Great Saint were formed at considerable cost.

If possible, no Chaos Great Saint would want to abandon their main battle body. Lin Yuan’s decision not to kill Black Light, Wild Barbarian, and the others could only mean that negotiations were taking place.

"I suppose Black Light and Wild Barbarian are being extorted by the Galaxy Great Saint..."

For some reason, Dual Origin Great Saint felt quite relieved.

He had made considerable sacrifices to rush to the vicinity of the Xuanhuang Universe using the Altar Spirit.

Now, having withdrawn from the Xuanhuang Universe with nothing to show for it, this journey was a complete loss.

But compared to Black Light Great Saint and Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Dual Origin Great Saint felt somewhat ’lucky’?

At least while being extorted by the Altar Spirit, he didn’t have to be extorted by Galaxy Great Saint as well.

...

Outside the universe.

Watching as the newly-appointed Great Saints, Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint, had their bodies and souls rapidly obliterated, the other nearby Chaos Great Saints couldn’t help but shiver.

What did Galaxy Great Saint mean by this?

"Rest assured, as long as you gather enough Chaos Stones to bring over, you can leave alive."

Lin Yuan glanced over the many Great Saints and spoke.

He directly obliterated Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint, not even giving them a chance to negotiate.

This was primarily due to personal grudges with these two Great Saints.

The premature destruction of his home universe was a result of the collateral damage from these two Chaos Great Saints’ battles.

If Lin Yuan’s strength had progressed a bit slower, and he hadn’t reached the Twelfth Layer before the cosmic cataclysm, he might have perished along with the universe.

Without reaching the Twelfth Layer, the essence imprint of his life would continue to be bound within the river of time.

During the cosmic cataclysm, the river of time would gradually collapse and dry up, eradicating all life essence imprints within it.

No matter the strength of Lin Yuan’s life essence, as long as it remained within the river of time, it would be destroyed in the collapse, per the rules of the Chaos Void.

At that time, if Lin Yuan wanted to survive, he could only transfer his life’s essence imprint to the inner universe of the nine paramount beings of human civilization.

However, with the premature arrival of the cosmic cataclysm, the hope for the paramount beings of human civilization to endure the cataclysm would inevitably diminish, and if the inner universe of the paramount being that housed Lin Yuan’s essence imprint collapsed, he would still die.

Normally, with a premature cosmic cataclysm, countless civilians of human civilization would undoubtedly perish heavily, and so would the paramount beings.

Although all this changed because of Lin Yuan, allowing the human civilization group to smoothly survive the cosmic cataclysm, Lin Yuan had already marked these two Great Saints in his heart back then.

Without the power previously, there was nothing Lin Yuan could do about the two Great Saints, so he had to endure.

Now with these two Great Saints in his hands, Lin Yuan naturally seized the opportunity for revenge.

Of course, there was another reason for Lin Yuan’s action against Nine Phoenix and Shadow Demon.

These newly appointed Great Saints had very limited resources they could offer.

To reach the pinnacle of the Chaos Realm, Chaos Venerable had already exhausted numerous resources they had accumulated, and the two Great Saints had been continuously fighting since their breakthroughs, leaving no time to accumulate resources and Chaos Stones.

...

"The Chaos Great Saints that I once could only admire from afar have now become not so mighty." Lin Yuan thought with some emotion.

At the same time, he looked around at the other Chaos Great Saints and smiled, saying, "I’ll give you time to consider, but it won’t be long."

Based on the strength of each Chaos Great Saint, Lin Yuan set a price, such as ten billion Chaos Stones for the powerful ones like Black Light and Wild Barbarian.

Weaker Chaos Great Saints faced five billion or three billion Chaos Stones.

By Lin Yuan’s estimation, these costs were close to the acceptable limits for each Chaos Great Saint.

Any more, and the Chaos Great Saints would prefer to abandon their main battle body rather than agree to the cost.

The difficulty of cultivating a main battle body simply boiled down to the cost involved; if the cost became too high, exceeding the time and effort needed to cultivate a new body, the Chaos Great Saints would choose to cultivate a new main battle body.

"Thank you, Galaxy Great Saint."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint exchanged a glance. With the involvement of ten billion Chaos Stones, even if they wanted to gather them, it would take time.

...

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Ever since discovering that the mysterious Great Saint who appeared last bore a remarkable resemblance to ’Galaxy,’ Ancient Ming Venerable began paying close attention to intelligence from within the Xuanhuang Universe.

"What? Ten Great Saints fought over a priceless treasure, and the mysterious Great Saint swept through the nine others single-handedly, with only Dual Origin Great Saint escaping and immediately swearing to leave the Postnatal Universe..."

"And finally, Dual Origin Great Saint swore, referring to that mysterious Great Saint as ’Galaxy Great Saint’?"

"Galaxy Great Saint? Galaxy?"

Ancient Ming Venerable was somewhat stupefied. If previously he had only suspected, without any concrete evidence, that the mysterious Great Saint was Galaxy,

after all, he was not present to confirm this through personal observation; the images he received only felt familiar and similar.

But now?

Ancient Ming Venerable was almost certain that the mysterious Great Saint was indeed Galaxy.

How could there be such a coincidence, with both resemblance and the same name?

"Galaxy..."

Ancient Ming Venerable was overwhelmingly shocked. Even though he knew that Lin Yuan was destined to stand atop the Chaos Void one day, it all happened so quickly.

How long has it been?

"Fortunately, I have already established a good relationship with Galaxy Great Saint, and even without a positive bond, at least I wouldn’t provoke resentment." Ancient Ming Venerable displayed a smile.

When facing such formidable power, it’s better to have no blame than no merit.

"Wasn’t it because of my reminder?" The young man in the black robe was also reviewing the intelligence about ’Galaxy Great Saint’ and couldn’t resist claiming credit.

"Yes, yes, your reminder was indeed timely back then."

Ancient Ming Venerable acknowledged.

This was true, for if not for the young man in the black robe, he wouldn’t have noticed Lin Yuan back then at all.

Not noticing meant he wouldn’t pay special attention, and if this ancestor had an unpleasant encounter on the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, wouldn’t Ancient Ming have to take the fall?

...

The battle within the Xuanhuang Universe, spread by observing Chaos Venerables, swept through the Void Domain like a hurricane, and the fame of Galaxy Great Saint resounded thoroughly throughout the Chaos Void.

Initially, some Chaos Venerables and even Great Saints did not believe it, but as time passed, and as Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints did not actively deny it,

many Venerable Saints and Great Saints immediately realized that the news might be true; otherwise, why wouldn’t Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint step forward?

...

Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan stood there silently, as his external universe operated, immense Power of Space-Time continuously pressed towards the nearby Dark Sky Palace.

Dark forces permeated around the Dark Sky Palace, capable of threatening the Chaos Great Saints.

Even a strong entity like Dual Origin Great Saint would have to give their all to resist such power; retrieving the Dark Sky Heart from the palace would take quite some time.

But for Lin Yuan now, while not effortlessly, it was nearly so.

Rumble.

The power of the external universe swept forth, and the dark power surrounding the Dark Sky Palace began to visibly obliterate and dissipate.

After more than ten breaths.

The dark power surrounding the Dark Sky Palace was completely dispelled, leaving the black palace exposed before Lin Yuan.

Buzz.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, reaching towards the Dark Sky Palace.

When he drew it back.

A crystal stone, exuding a profound dark aura and resembling a beating heart.

Appeared in Lin Yuan’s palm.
